title: Maximal ideal generation along a split trait section
statement: Let $S$ be a normal integral Noetherian quasi-separated scheme, $c:C\to S$ a quasi-compact quasi-separated smooth morphism with geometrically connected fibres, $\sigma:S\to C$ a section, and $G$ a finite group with order invertible in $\Gamma(S,\mathcal O_S)$ [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-sbc-normal-dominant-galois, def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. Let $q:C_\eta\to\operatorname{Spec}k(S)$ and $j:C_\eta\to C$ exhibit the generic fibre [def-pc-fibre-product], with a section $s_\eta$ satisfying $q s_\eta=1$ and $j s_\eta=\sigma a_\eta$. Let $Z\to C_\eta$ be a finite etale $G$-torsor with a rational point above $s_\eta$. Let $U\subset S$ contain $\eta$, let $P\to C_U$ be finite etale, and let $j_U:C_\eta\to C_U$ and $\psi:Z\to P$ exhibit its generic restriction, with $i_Uj_U=j$. Let $s\notin U$ be such that every $t\notin U$ specializing to $s$ equals $s$. Put $a:\operatorname{Spec}\mathcal O_{S,s}\to S$, $L=C\times_S\operatorname{Spec}\mathcal O_{S,s}$, $l:L\to C$, and let $N\to C$ be the concrete relative normalization of $P\to C_U\to C$. Let $\tau=(a\sigma,1):\operatorname{Spec}\mathcal O_{S,s}\to L$ be the induced section. Assume $\mathcal O_{S,s}$ is a discrete valuation ring and that $n:N\times_C L\to L$ is finite. For each point $x$ of $N\times_C L$ with $n(x)=\tau(\mathfrak m_{S,s})$, the ideal of $\mathcal O_{N\times_C L,x}$ generated by the image of the maximal ideal of $\mathcal O_{L,n(x)}$ under the canonical stalk map is precisely the maximal ideal of $\mathcal O_{N\times_C L,x}$.

proof.text: Obtain the cyclic local chart data: a flat local map beta from the normalization stalk to a local ring D, a positive exponent e, a ramification coordinate t, and a root z of a uniformizer pi in a field with integer-valued order. The maximal ideal of D is J D + (t), and t^e lies in J D.

Apply the order homomorphism to z^e=pi. In additive notation this gives e ord(z)=1. Positivity of e forces ord(z)>0, so the integer ord(z) is at least one and e is at most one. Therefore e=1 and t lies in J D. The displayed generating formula gives m_D=J D. This arithmetic and ideal calculation is proved directly in Lean.

A flat local map of local rings is faithfully flat (Mathlib Module.FaithfullyFlat.of_flat_of_isLocalHom). Contract m_D=J D along beta. Faithful flatness gives (J D) cap B=J, and locality gives m_D cap B=m_B (Mathlib Ideal.comap_map_eq_self_of_faithfullyFlat and IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_comap). Thus J=m_B, as required. This descent is proved directly in Lean.

    (hCη : IsPullback q j (S.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint S)) c)
    (sη : Spec S.functionField ⟶ Cη) (hsq : sη ≫ q = 𝟙 _)
    (hsj : sη ≫ j = S.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint S) ≫ σ)
    (Z : GaloisCover G Cη) (hZ : ∃ z : Spec S.functionField ⟶ Z.P, z ≫ Z.π = sη)
    (U : S.Opens) (hηU : genericPoint S ∈ U)
    (jU : Cη ⟶ (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme) (PA : (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme.FiniteEtale)

    (hψ : IsPullback ψ Z.π PA.obj.hom jU)
    (s : S) (hs : s ∉ U)
    (hmin : ∀ t : S, t ⤳ s → t ∉ U → t = s)
    (hdvr : IsDiscreteValuationRing (S.presheaf.stalk s)) :
    letI : IsFinite PA.obj.hom := PA.property
    letI : QuasiCompact (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι :=
      MorphismProperty.of_isPullback (isPullback_morphismRestrict c U)
        (inferInstance : QuasiCompact U.ι)
    let a := S.fromSpecStalk s
    let n := pullback.snd (PA.obj.hom ≫ (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).fromNormalization (pullback.fst c a)
    let τ : Spec (S.presheaf.stalk s) ⟶ pullback c a :=
      pullback.lift (a ≫ σ) (𝟙 _) (by simp [Category.assoc, hσ])
    IsFinite n → ∀ x : (pullback (PA.obj.hom ≫ (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).fromNormalization
      (pullback.fst c a) : Scheme.{u}),
      n x = τ (IsLocalRing.closedPoint (S.presheaf.stalk s)) →
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ((pullback c a).presheaf.stalk (n x))).map
